item.tib: g.yung drung rnam par 'joms pa'i bsnyen bsgrub las sbyor phyag bzhes lag len 'od dkar snying po
item.coloph: zhes g.yung drung rnam par 'joms pa'i bsnyen bsgrub (sgrub) las gsum gyi lag len 'od dkar snying po zhes bya ba 'di/ mdo la gzungs btus gsang rigs kun 'dus snying po ru snang phyir/ bsnyen pa dang bsgrub (sgrub) pa'i lag len byas pa yin shing / las sbyor bzlog (zlog)pa'i skor zur byung kha 'thor zhig snang ba dang / snga rabs kha cig gi stong bzlog (zlog)gi bca' zin 'dra min gnyis tsam mthong ba yid ches tsam 'dug pa dang*/ gang gi sgo nas btags (brtags) kyang lung 'di nyid kyi tshigs su snang ba dang / dpyad pa'i byab khrus bzlog (zlog)pa sogs sprad pa'i lag len bca' zin rnams/ mdo smad kyi zhing 'dir mtshan dang don mtshungs pa rje rin po che g.yung drung bstan 'dzin gyis/ 'di ltar gyis shig pa'i bka' rtsal (brtsal) bzhin/ thos chung dz+nya na hri d+hIHsa sa phag zla ba'i tshes la legs par/ bkra shis smin grol khrod du sug bris bgyis pa dge'o//
